miniapp.name: TokenizedBlock
miniapp.subtitle: Build a block, open its market on Base
miniapp.description: Build a block — name, symbol, supply, colour — and it becomes a B-20 native token on Base with a permanent Uniswap v4 market. Its supply is minted at birth and equals its cap; your wallet stays the block's admin.
miniapp.ogTitle: TokenizedBlock — make a living block on Base
miniapp.ogDescription: Build a block. It becomes a B-20 token on Base, and its market opens in the same signature.
